lines.en: I creep along the edge of the tree shadows
I stop every few steps
I slip around the back of a trunk

lines.zh: 我的脚踩在落叶上，很轻
lines.en: My feet press the leaf litter softly

lines.zh: 我始终和你保持一扇门的距离
lines.en: I keep one door's width from you

lines.zh: 我侧着身子走，像在躲什么
lines.en: I walk side-on, as if hiding from something
The dark flows over me

lines.zh: 我不发出声音，连衣角也不
lines.en: I make no sound, not even my hem

lines.zh: 我往回走了两步，又往前
lines.en: I step back twice, then forward

lines.zh: 我在几个树之间选了最近的
lines.en: I pick the nearest gap between trees
I raise my head to judge the distance
I slide into the next patch of shade

lines.zh: 我站在树旁，和树分不清
lines.en: I stand by the tree and look like part of it
I haven't moved in a long while
My breathing is almost nothing

lines.zh: 我看不见的地方，我也在看
lines.en: I'm watching even where I can't be seen
There's a gap behind the door and I'm in it
I have no face, yet I stare
You move in the house; I count
Look my way and I'm gone
I fold myself into the shadow

lines.zh: 风穿过我，我像没有身体
lines.en: Wind passes through me as if I have no body
I'm patient; there's no rush

lines.zh: 这片树荫很久都没动了
lines.en: This shade hasn't moved in a long time
You turn, and I'm somewhere else
I wait for you to notice me first
Being looked at so long, I can't hold still
I count to your third breath
I press flat against the bark

lines.zh: 树叶响的时候我也动一下
lines.en: When leaves stir, I stir too
I hide behind the door, half showing
You've been looking a long while
You looked when you shouldn't
I lean a little from behind the tree
The longer you look, the clearer I get
I meant to hide a while longer
Your eyes haven't moved away
Now I stand before you
Your breath skipped a beat
Being watched makes me restless
I tilt my head; you don't
Stop looking this way
Just another moment

lines.zh: 我想走近，你看着我就行
lines.en: I want to come closer; just keep watching
I scatter, then gather again
I withdraw slowly into the dark

lines.zh: 被打的地方像破了个口
lines.en: The wound feels like a hole

lines.zh: 我没有叫，只是抖了一下
lines.en: I don't cry out; I only shudder
I press back behind the tree again
I grow a shade fainter

lines.zh: 我抓起一片影子挡住自己
lines.en: I pull a shadow over myself

lines.zh: 我退了半步，你追上来了
lines.en: I retreat half a step; you follow
It shouldn't hurt, yet it does
I lower my head and say nothing
That little light in your hand
Bright things bother me
I want to come near, but I don't dare
Turn the lamp off and it's different
That smell; I haven't known it in ages
You hold it up and I retreat

lines.zh: 我还记得自己爱过什么
lines.en: I remember what I used to love

lines.zh: 把东西放下，慢慢往后退
lines.en: Put it down and back away slowly
My neck stretches, and it's still too far
Next time remember to put the light out

lines.zh: 你撞上了我，我几乎没有实体
lines.en: You lurch into me; I'm hardly solid

lines.zh: 我退开一点，像水被拨开
lines.en: I give way like water parting

lines.zh: 你的肩膀穿过我的一半
lines.en: Your shoulder passes halfway through me
I press against your back
What you feel is a chill
I hit the door and it doesn't move
Neither of us gives ground
I'm right before your nose
You reach out and catch nothing

lines.zh: 我被撞散了一点，又聚回来
lines.en: The blow scatters me; I gather again

lines.zh: 树后还有另一个不说话的影子
lines.en: Another silent shadow waits behind the tree
We take a door each, left and right
It's fainter than I am

lines.zh: 我们靠在一起，像两块暗
lines.en: We lean together like two patches of dark
The one watching begins to panic

lines.zh: 我们同时往前挪了一点
lines.en: We shift forward at the same instant
Its shadow swallows mine
We don't need words
This wood can hide two
Tonight neither of us moves first

lines.zh: 我从门后的地上捡起来
lines.en: I pick it up from behind the door
It isn't mine and I hold it anyway
I cup it in both hands
It has some warmth; I'm not used to it
I set it on the windowsill
It dims in my hands
I keep it, hidden in a tree hollow
I drop it and stoop to feel for it
This thing smells of you

lines.zh: 你发现它不见了，会很着急
lines.en: You'll be upset when it's missing
At last you looked this way
I'm not hiding anymore
I'm about to lunge at you
You're still standing there
That tree behind you is too close
I watch you and step forward
I'm wide awake now

lines.zh: 我扑过来的时候，你会看到一点白
lines.en: When I lunge you'll see a sliver of white
This time I won't hide
Just this once, and quickly
I follow, always behind a tree
Speed up and I speed up
There's one more shadow by the door
You look back; that side's empty
You haven't seen me, but I'm there
My charge makes no sound

lines.zh: 你的手一直没放下武器
lines.en: You haven't lowered that weapon

lines.zh: 这片光够不着的地方，都是我的
lines.en: Everywhere the light can't reach is mine

lines.zh: 你开始怀疑每一处阴影
lines.en: You're starting to doubt every shadow
My patience never sleeps
You can't count how many of me there are
I'm right behind your head

lines.zh: 我撞进你的身体，一阵冷
lines.en: I plunge into you; it's cold

lines.zh: 我的手从你肩后伸过来
lines.en: My hand comes over your shoulder
I lunge and hold you down, very lightly

lines.zh: 你被撞得退了一步，气也乱了
lines.en: The impact steals a step and your breath

lines.zh: 我的手指按在你脖子上
lines.en: My fingers rest on your throat
That lunge scattered even me
I cling, and you can't shake me off
This time I've got you
You swing at nothing; I'm beside you
Your strength is draining

lines.zh: 门后有一道影子，本来没有
lines.en: A shadow behind the door that wasn't there

lines.zh: 树边多了一个不该有的人形
lines.en: A figure by the tree that shouldn't be
First I show only one eye
I've stood here a while
Someone lit a lamp indoors
I've been following you a long while
The leaves didn't move; I did
First I watch you from a distance
An eye in the door's gap
The air cools a little
My shadow reaches the wall first
You haven't seen me yet
I appear and the light dims
Let me come a little closer first
The firelight drives me shrinking back

lines.zh: 我从树上掉下来，散成一片
lines.en: I fall from the tree and scatter

lines.zh: 水灌进我身体，我变得很重
lines.en: Water fills me and I grow heavy

lines.zh: 爆光冲过来，我几乎散了
lines.en: The blast light hits me and I nearly come apart
The arrow passes through and leaves a hole

lines.zh: 魔法钉住了我，我动不了
lines.en: Magic pins me and I can't move

lines.zh: 太久没靠近活人，我快没了
lines.en: Too long without a living soul; I'm fading

lines.zh: 雷光照透我，我整个人被看得清楚
lines.en: The flash shows all of me

lines.zh: 这里没有影子，我无处可藏
lines.en: No shadows here; nowhere to hide
